subtitle: Integrated Math and Science for Engineering Ⅱ

keywords: Definite and indefinite integrals 2.Differential equations 3.Line integrals and energy 4.Moment of force 5.Community cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) definite and indefinite integrals, integration by parts and by substitution. (2) equations of motion (separable, 1st order linear and 2nd order homogeneous linear differential equations) as an application of integrals. (3) line integrals and energy. (4) moment of force, center of gravity, and inertia moment.
advice: This is a basic course in integrated mathematics and science for engineering. We will cover the following topics: 1. Sum of numerical sequence and its limit, definite and indefinite integrals, integration by parts and by substitution. 2. 1st order differential equations, 2nd order linear differential equations, equations of motion and mechanics. 3. Line integral, work and energy, motion of a system of particles. 4. Area of a shape, multiple integral, volume of a solid, center of gravity, rotational motion and inertia moment. Extra classes may be held depending the comprehension level of students. Students are required to review and preview each class. As a matter of particular emphasis, students are required to attempt the exercises after each class. Extra materials may be distributed if necessary. Students are required to show their solution/calculation procedure logically and clearly in each assignment. Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
books: Textbook: Integrated Math and Science for Engineering II Reference books: Integrated Math and Science for Engineering I Reader of Calculas - 1 variable -, Visual Approach [Mechanics] Engineering Mathematics Text Series - Calculas -
requiredKnowledge: Skills and knowledge from Integrated Math and Science for Engineering I. Knowledge of exponential functions, logarithmic functions, and trigonometric functions. Basic calculation skills for differentiation.

activityGoals.body: Calculate the integrals of various functions and integration by parts and by substitution.
Solve separable, 1st order linear and 2nd order homogeneous linear differential equations.
Understand the concept of line integral, and explain the energy of a system.
Calculate the areas of shapes, the volumes of a solid, the inertia moment, and the center of gravity of solids.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for mathematics.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend every class, and do the required work.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately calculate integrals of basic functions and use integration by substitution and by parts. (2) Fully understand the equations of motion and accurately solve separable, 1st order linear and 2nd order homogeneous linear differential equations. (3) Accurately calculate line integrals, and explain the energy of a system correctly. (4) Accurately calculate areas and volumes using definite integrals and find the center of gravity. (5) Fully understand multiple integrals and accurately calculate moments of inertia. (6) Demonstrate an understanding of all topics and complete all homework.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Calculate integrals of basic functions and use integration by substitution and by parts. (2) Understand the equations of motion, and solve separable, 1st order linear and 2nd order homogeneous linear differential equations. (3) Calculate line integrals and explain the energy of a system. (4) Calculate areas and volumes using definite integrals and find the center of gravity. (5) Understand multiple integrals and calculate moments of inertia. (6) Demonstrate an understanding of all topics and complete all homework.
